title: Meaningful change: open biological variation estimates and reference change values
description: An open table of within-subject (CVI) and between-subject (CVG) biological variation estimates for 129 laboratory analytes (123 with a primary estimate), each copied from the full text of a published study or meta-analysis with DOI and table location, plus cited RCV equations (symmetric and log-normal), a Python reference implementation and a TypeScript function tested against published reference change values. No content from the EFLM Biological Variation Database is included.
notes: Code (src/, scripts/, tests/) is under the MIT licence.
